materials.title: 预测与条件下的安排

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前审核。

questions.prompt: Choose the prediction with a normal verb form: The morning ____ cloudy.
questions.evidence: I think the morning will be cloudy.
questions.explanation: will 后用动词原形 be。

questions.prompt: Which sentence expresses an uncertain possibility?
options: It might rains in the afternoon.
It might rain in the afternoon.
It might to rain in the afternoon.
It rains might in the afternoon.
answers: It might rain in the afternoon.
questions.evidence: It might rain in the afternoon.
questions.explanation: might 表示可能，后接 rain 原形。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct negative prediction.
questions.evidence: It might not rain.
questions.explanation: might 的否定为 might not，后面仍接原形 rain。

questions.prompt: Complete: We ____ need an umbrella tomorrow.
questions.evidence: It might rain in the afternoon.
questions.explanation: 对不确定的将来作预测可用 might + 动词原形。

questions.prompt: Look at the dark cloud. It ____ rain soon.
questions.evidence: It is going to rain.
questions.explanation: 根据眼前黑云预测，用 is going to + 动词原形。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct evidence-based prediction.
options: The sky is dark. It is going to rains.
The sky is dark. It is going raining.
The sky is dark. It going to rain.
The sky is dark. It is going to rain.
answers: The sky is dark. It is going to rain.
questions.evidence: Look at that dark cloud. It is going to rain.
questions.explanation: 先有黑云证据，再用 is going to rain。

questions.prompt: Complete: Look at those clouds! They ____ cover the sun.
questions.evidence: It is going to rain.
questions.explanation: 复数 clouds 对应 are，going to 后用原形 cover。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct verb after going to.
questions.evidence: It is going to rain.
questions.explanation: going to 后接 rain 的原形。

questions.prompt: If it rains, we ____ inside.
questions.evidence: If it rains, we will move inside.
questions.explanation: if 从句一般现在时，主句 will + move 原形。

questions.prompt: If it ____ safe, the children will plant outside.
questions.evidence: If it is safe, the children will plant outside.
questions.explanation: if 从句用一般现在时，it 对应 is。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct future condition.
options: If it rains, we will move inside.
If it rains, we will moves inside.
If it will rain, we will move inside.
If it raining, we move will inside.
answers: If it rains, we will move inside.
questions.evidence: If it rains, we will move inside.
questions.explanation: 未来条件句的 if 从句不用 will；主句用 will move。

questions.prompt: Which sentence means the same as “If it rains, we will move inside”?
options: We move inside if it will rain.
If we move inside, it will rain.
We will rain if it moves inside.
We will move inside if it rains.
answers: We will move inside if it rains.
questions.evidence: We will move inside if it rains.
questions.explanation: 两个分句可以交换顺序，条件和结果保持相同。

materials.instructions: 先阅读说明与例句，再作答并根据解释订正。
materials.passage:
1. will / might 表示预测：I think the morning will be cloudy. 说话人认为会发生；It might rain in the afternoon. 表示可能发生但不确定。两者后接动词原形；否定分别是 will not / won't 与 might not。It might not rain. 不要写 might rains。

2. 根据眼前证据预测，可用 be going to + 动词原形：Look at that dark cloud. It is going to rain. 黑云是眼前证据，不是已发生的雨；不要漏掉 is，也不要在 going to 后加 rains。

3. 真实可能的未来条件常用 if + 一般现在时，主句 will + 动词原形：If it rains, we will move inside. 即使说将来，if 从句也用 rains，不写 if it will rain。顺序可以互换：We will move inside if it rains. If it is safe, the children will plant outside. 条件成立时才发生主句动作；这不是保证预报一定准确。

materials.title: A Garden Day with a Backup Plan

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前审核。

questions.prompt: Why does Mia prepare two places for the activity?
options: The garden is closed for a year.
questions.evidence: Because the weather may change, Mia asks the team to prepare both an outside table and a room inside the community center.
questions.explanation: 天气可能变化，因此她为室内外都作准备。

questions.prompt: What temperature does Friday’s forecast suggest?
questions.evidence: The temperature is likely to reach 14 degrees Celsius.
questions.explanation: 原文预计温度为 14 摄氏度。

questions.prompt: Why does Mia move the paper instructions indoors?
options: A gardener has taken the seeds.
She thinks it is going to rain.
answers: She thinks it is going to rain.
questions.evidence: Mia thinks the rain is going to start soon, so she moves the paper instructions indoors.
questions.explanation: so 前是原因：她看到云后认为很快会下雨。

questions.prompt: What could the wind do to the instructions?
options: Fold the papers against the table.
questions.evidence: A strong wind could blow the papers away even if the ground stays dry.
questions.explanation: 强风即使在地面干燥时也可能吹走纸张。

questions.prompt: What should the group do when they hear thunder?
questions.evidence: The center has a simple rule for a storm: everyone goes inside when they hear thunder or see lightning.
questions.explanation: 听到雷声或看见闪电时，规则要求进入室内。

questions.prompt: What can children take home from the indoor activity?
questions.evidence: The indoor activity uses small pots, soil and seeds, so the children can still take a plant home.
questions.explanation: 室内活动同样让孩子带走一株植物。

questions.prompt: Why does the team water plants early in summer?
options: The center has no water later.
questions.evidence: Summer can be hot, so the garden team waters plants early.
questions.explanation: 夏天可能炎热，因此团队提早浇水。

questions.prompt: Where are young plants sometimes moved on a freezing night?
questions.evidence: On a freezing night, volunteers sometimes move young plants into a sheltered room.
questions.explanation: 严寒夜晚，志愿者有时把幼苗移入有遮蔽的房间。

questions.prompt: What does the gardener say climate describes?
questions.evidence: The gardener also reminds Mia that climate describes patterns over many years, while a forecast describes expected conditions at a particular time.
questions.explanation: climate 指多年的规律；forecast 是特定时间的预计状况。

questions.prompt: When will Mia check the new report?
options: Only after everyone has planted outside.
After the event ends on Friday.
Before the families arrive on Sunday.
While the families are leaving on Saturday.
answers: Before the families arrive on Sunday.
questions.evidence: On Sunday morning, Mia will check the new report before the families arrive.
questions.explanation: 她计划周日早上、家庭到来前再次查看报告。

materials.instructions: Read the passage and choose ONE answer for each question.
materials.passage:
Mia helps at a neighborhood garden. On Sunday, she and other volunteers plan to show children how to plant seeds. The weather may change, so Mia reads the forecast on Friday. It says the morning will be cloudy, but there may be sunshine after lunch. The temperature is likely to reach 14 degrees Celsius. Because the weather may change, Mia asks the team to prepare both an outside table and a room inside the community center.

Last year the same event was sunny, and the children worked outside all day. This year a dark cloud has appeared over the hills earlier than expected. Mia thinks the rain is going to start soon, so she moves the paper instructions indoors. A strong wind could blow the papers away even if the ground stays dry. Each child will need an umbrella if they walk between the room and the garden during rain.

The center has a simple rule for a storm: everyone goes inside when they hear thunder or see lightning. The group will wait in the room until staff say it is safe to return. The indoor activity uses small pots, soil and seeds, so the children can still take a plant home. Mia checks that the room has enough chairs and a place to wash hands.

A local gardener offers to explain why conditions differ through the year. In spring, the town is usually mild and the soil becomes warm enough for seeds. Summer can be hot, so the garden team waters plants early. In autumn, a windy day may bring leaves onto the paths. Winter is the cold season; a snowy morning is exciting for children, but snow can cover the small plants. On a freezing night, volunteers sometimes move young plants into a sheltered room.

The gardener also reminds Mia that climate describes patterns over many years, while a forecast describes expected conditions at a particular time. A rainy week does not explain the whole climate of the town. Fog sometimes makes the road hard to see, and high humidity can make a warm room feel uncomfortable. These details help the team decide when to open windows and when to offer an indoor space.

On Sunday morning, Mia will check the new report before the families arrive. If the sky stays safe, the children will plant outside. If conditions change, they will use the room instead. The activity has a clear purpose in either place: each child can learn how to care for a seed.

materials.title: Planning the Saturday Picnic

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前审核。

questions.prompt: What is Nora bringing to the picnic?
questions.evidence: I am bringing the food, so I need to know where we will eat.
questions.explanation: Nora 说明自己负责带食物。

questions.prompt: What temperature is expected on Saturday?
questions.evidence: Saturday should be warm, around 22 degrees Celsius, but the afternoon might be rainy.
questions.explanation: Ben 说周六大约 22 摄氏度。

questions.prompt: What does Nora think the cloud indicates?
questions.evidence: I think it is going to rain before noon.
questions.explanation: Nora 根据黑云预测中午前下雨。

questions.prompt: Where will the group meet if it stays dry?
questions.evidence: If it stays dry, we will meet under the large tree at eleven.
questions.explanation: 干燥时的集合地点是大树下。

questions.prompt: Where will the group go if rain starts?
options: The far side of the lake.
questions.evidence: If rain starts, we will move to the cafe beside the path.
questions.explanation: 下雨时改去小路旁的咖啡馆。

questions.prompt: How many people are in their group?
questions.evidence: The cafe has room for eight people, and our group has only six.
questions.explanation: 咖啡馆可容纳八人，但他们的组只有六人。

questions.prompt: What will they do if they hear thunder or see lightning?
questions.evidence: If we hear thunder or see lightning, we will go straight inside.
questions.explanation: 一有雷声或闪电就立即进室内。

questions.prompt: What can fog hide in winter?
options: The other side of the lake.
answers: The other side of the lake.
questions.evidence: The lake looks very different in each season. In winter, fog sometimes hides the other side.
questions.explanation: 前句谈湖泊，the other side 指湖的另一边。

questions.prompt: When will Nora send the meeting places?
questions.evidence: I will send everyone the two meeting places by nine thirty.
questions.explanation: nine thirty 是发送两个地点的截止时间。

questions.prompt: What will Ben do at ten?
questions.evidence: I will check the new report at ten and call you if anything changes.
questions.explanation: Ben 会在十点查新报告，有变化再联系 Nora。

materials.instructions: Listen to the two speakers and choose ONE answer for each question. The facts differ from the reading.
materials.transcript:
Nora: Have you seen the weather forecast for our picnic by the lake? I am bringing the food, so I need to know where we will eat.
Ben: Yes. Saturday should be warm, around 22 degrees Celsius, but the afternoon might be rainy. The morning will be sunny according to the latest report.
Nora: There is a dark cloud above the lake already. I think it is going to rain before noon. Should we cancel everything?
Ben: I would wait. A cloud can pass quickly, and the wind is moving it toward the hills. Let's plan for both possibilities.
Nora: Good idea. If it stays dry, we will meet under the large tree at eleven. If rain starts, we will move to the cafe beside the path.
Ben: I will bring an umbrella and a cloth for the food. The cafe has room for eight people, and our group has only six.
Nora: What about a storm? Last summer we heard thunder during a walk, and then we saw lightning. I do not want anyone to stay outside in that situation.
Ben: If we hear thunder or see lightning, we will go straight inside. We can ask the cafe staff when it is safe to leave.
Nora: The lake looks very different in each season. In winter, fog sometimes hides the other side. I remember one cold, snowy visit when the ground was freezing.
Ben: I prefer spring. The climate here is mild, and even a windy day can feel pleasant. Today the humidity is high, though, so let us take plenty of water.
Nora: Agreed. The sunshine may return later, but we can enjoy lunch indoors too. I will send everyone the two meeting places by nine thirty.
Ben: Thanks. I will check the new report at ten and call you if anything changes.

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前审核。

materials.instructions: Prepare briefly, then record your own answer. Speak for 90–120 seconds and use at least six lesson words.
materials.prompt: Describe an outdoor activity you would like to arrange. Explain what weather you expect, what evidence you can see, and what you will do if conditions change. Speak for 90–120 seconds and use at least six lesson words.
materials.reference: I would like to have a picnic with my friends near a lake in spring. I will check the weather forecast the night before and again in the morning. I think the day will be warm, but it might be windy. If I see a dark cloud, I will take an umbrella. If it is going to rain, we will use a nearby cafe instead of sitting outside. We will go indoors immediately if we hear thunder or see lightning. I enjoy sunshine, but a little rain will not end our plan. The important thing is to tell everyone both meeting places before they leave home. Then nobody needs to wait in the wrong place.
